_comment: The config half of the case, frozen from the run that produced the baseline beats.json (video vid_5f9497eed63a). A case is only reproducible if the style pack and channel rules it was scored under are pinned beside the script: overlays.density and overlays.emphasis decide how many graphics are even legal, so a case re-run under a different pack is a different question.

style_pack_doc.name: breakdown-blitz
style_pack_doc.script_persona: Rapid analyst. One idea per sentence, numbers up front, no wind-up. Every second earns the next.
style_pack_doc.visual_language: Tight close-ups, mechanisms and hands, hard cuts between scales; avoid slow establishing drone shots.
